thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened docs PR #412 for the v2 -> v3 migration guide. Needs 2 approvals and we should coordinate merge timing with the 2.3 release cutoff.

mike: Can you drop the docs-preview link? Also is this safe to merge before the feature flag lands?

elaine: preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/412 — CI shows the build but there's one broken SDK snippet I fixed in a follow-up commit.

deploy-bot: docs preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/preview/412 (status: success)

sai: I reviewed the snippet — broken example was the python client import path. New commit looks good. Small nit: the code fence uses old param name `max_tokens`, should be `max_new_tokens` for our SDK v3.

elaine: thanks @sai — updated to `max_new_tokens`. pushed.

joan: (not in thread)

zoe: tagging release: we need to be careful. The feature-flag ff/v3-migration is scheduled to canary on 2025-11-12. Would prefer docs to land only after canary or behind a versioned path so users don't see unstable steps.

mike: option: land under /2.3/migration/v3/ and mark with "beta" banner, or hold until FF flip. Which do you prefer?

elaine: leaning toward landing in versioned folder so we can publish with the release but keep it gated from top-level nav. That way early adopters on the canary can follow it, but the main site stays stable.

jen: QA note — if we publish early, please add a small checklist section at bottom: "If you're on canary, do X; otherwise skip". I can add a quick validation step.

zoe: ok. If it's versioned under /2.3/ and we don't add redirects, ops will be fine. Just coordinate the merge window: our cutoff for docs that require release sync is 2025-11-08 23:59 UTC.

sai: timeline-wise: if we merge now into a draft /2.3/ path, it won't affect the published nav. Also confirm the front matter has `version: 2.3` and `status: beta`.

elaine: done — front matter updated in last commit: `version: "2.3"`, `status: "beta"`. Added the QA checklist per @jen.

mike: I can approve once jen signs off on QA item. @jen can you give a quick thumbs?

jen: Quick pass done — steps are clear. I validated the snippet with SDK v3 and the CLI command. :thumbsup:

mike: approved.

sai: approved as well.

zoe: Approved from release side, but please do not merge before 2025-11-09 02:00 UTC unless you explicitly need it earlier and notify release channel. We'll coordinate the actual publish post-canary on 2025-11-12.

elaine: understood. I'll hold merge until the merge window the release team clarified. If anything changes I'll ping #release.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: hold-merge flag set on PR #412 (meta: hold reason="release gating").

elaine: thanks all — will follow up if we need an emergency merge.

mike: small follow-up: add a one-line note in the changelog about the new migration steps so PMs can link it in release notes.

elaine: added changelog entry in the same PR. Good catch.

jen: all good from QA. I'll re-run smoke after you merge.

elaine: wrapping up — no merges until release window; thread closed for now.
